name: Udaymartand Rasa

sections.introduction: Udaymartand rasa is a herbo-mineral composition. This is an effective medicine for Udavarta, anaha (flatulence, constipation).
sections.ingredients:
Shuddha Hingula – 40 gms 
 Shuddha Jaiphal – 20 gms 
 Shuddha Suhaga – 10 gms 
 Shuddha Vatsanabha – 5 gms
sections.description_of_ingredients:
Shuddha Hingula – Botanically it is known as Red sulphide of mercury. It stimulates digestion and aids in relieving the pain and inflammation. This pacifies vata and kapha dosha.  
 Shuddha Jaiphal – Jaiphal is also known as Myristica fragrans. It promotes digestive fire. It corrects the balance of vata and kapha dosha mainly. This shows effectual results in relieving pain, inflammation and acts as liver tonic due to its hepatoprotective property.   
 Shuddha Vatsanabha – This is known as Aconitum ferox . This is used as medicine. But firstly detoxify this drug. It has antipyretic and diaphoretic properties. It pacifies vata, pitta and kapha dosha, especially balances the vata and kapha dosha. It is a very good analgesic and anti-inflammatory. 
 Shuddha Suhaga – This is also known as Citrus tankan. It improves digestion and relieves bloating. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Give proper frolement to all the above mentioned ingredients in a kharal yantra. 
 Now give water bhavna and make 250 mg tablets. 
 Let them dry and kept in glass container. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Udaymartand rasa is an Ayurvedic formulation. The ingredients in this formulation have digestive properties. They digest the Aama (Endotoxins) in the gut and maintain the digestive power.

sections.dosage:
2 tablets twice a day with plain water, extracts of Adraka (Zingiber officinale) or decoction of trikatu. 
 Cautions 

 Take under medical supervision. 
 Avoid this formulation in pregnancy. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Udaymartand Rasa 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Udavartanahrogadhikar 647/87-88 
 Introduction 
 Udaymartand rasa is a herbo-mineral composition. This is an effective medicine for Udavarta, anaha (flatulence, constipation). 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Hingula – 40 gms 
 Shuddha Jaiphal – 20 gms 
 Shuddha Suhaga – 10 gms 
 Shuddha Vatsanabha – 5 gms 
 
 Description of Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Hingula – Botanically it is known as Red sulphide of mercury. It stimulates digestion and aids in relieving the pain and inflammation. This pacifies vata and kapha dosha.  
 Shuddha Jaiphal – Jaiphal is also known as Myristica fragrans. It promotes digestive fire. It corrects the balance of vata and kapha dosha mainly. This shows effectual results in relieving pain, inflammation and acts as liver tonic due to its hepatoprotective property.   
 Shuddha Vatsanabha – This is known as Aconitum ferox . This is used as medicine. But firstly detoxify this drug. It has antipyretic and diaphoretic properties. It pacifies vata, pitta and kapha dosha, especially balances the vata and kapha dosha. It is a very good analgesic and anti-inflammatory. 
 Shuddha Suhaga – This is also known as Citrus tankan. It improves digestion and relieves bloating. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Give proper frolement to all the above mentioned ingredients in a kharal yantra. 
 Now give water bhavna and make 250 mg tablets. 
 Let them dry and kept in glass container. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Udaymartand rasa is an Ayurvedic formulation. The ingredients in this formulation have digestive properties. They digest the Aama (Endotoxins) in the gut and maintain the digestive power. 
 Indications 
 
 Indigestion

 Constipation

 Dosage 
 2 tablets twice a day with plain water, extracts of Adraka (Zingiber officinale) or decoction of trikatu.

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
